map.由缺陷数反推西格玛水平: Back-calculate sigma level from defect count
map.缺陷 24 个、产品 5 000 件、每单位机会 8 个：DPMO = 24×1: Defects 24, products 5,000, opportunities per unit 8: DPMO = 24×10⁶ ÷ (5,000×8) = 600. Yield = 1 − 600/10⁶ = 99.94%, corresponding long-term Z ≈ 3.24σ; by the 1.5σ long-term shift, short-term sigma level ≈ 4.74σ. To reach short-term 6σ, DPMO must drop to about 3.4, i.e. defects from 24 to within 1.
map.摩托罗拉实践发现长期运行的过程均值会相对短期漂移约 1.5σ，因此短期水平 =: Motorola practice found that long-running process means drift about 1.5σ relative to short-term, so short-term level = long-term level + 1.5. The industry saying "6σ = 3.4 DPMO" is derived from this.
map.指一个产品上可能出现缺陷的位置或检查项总数，例如一块 PCBA 有 200 个焊: It is the total number of positions or inspection items on a product where defects may occur, e.g. a PCBA with 200 solder joints has 200 opportunities. The same production line should fix the calibration, otherwise DPMO is not comparable.
